hero.name: First impression
hero.purpose: Choose a clear promise and a useful next step.

services.name: Services
services.purpose: Explain the work and who it helps.

work.name: Selected work
work.purpose: Show approved project imagery and context.

process.name: Process
process.purpose: Make the next steps easy to understand.

about.name: About
about.purpose: Introduce the business in its own words.

team.name: People
team.purpose: Show the accountable people behind the work.

faq.name: Questions
faq.purpose: Answer real questions before the first conversation.

areas.name: Service areas
areas.purpose: State confirmed coverage and travel boundaries.

testimonials.name: Client voices
testimonials.purpose: Use attributed feedback only with permission.

cta.name: Next step
cta.purpose: Offer one clear action at the right moment.

contact.name: Get in touch
contact.purpose: Explain contact options and delivery state.

resources.name: Useful reading
resources.purpose: Help visitors prepare and make decisions.

comparison.name: Compare options
comparison.purpose: Make scope differences easy to scan.

before-after.name: Before & after
before-after.purpose: Explain a transformation with visible context.

features.name: Features & capabilities
features.purpose: Highlight key capabilities and tangible visitor benefits.

logos.name: Proof & partners
logos.purpose: Display partner marks, accreditations, or press mentions.

timeline.name: Timeline & milestones
timeline.purpose: Show progressive phases, project milestones, or history.

bento.name: Bento highlights
bento.purpose: Group proof points, key metrics, and features in a visual cluster.

fit.name: Is this right for you?
fit.purpose: Help visitors recognize whether the service matches their needs.
fit.copy_guidance: Describe who benefits and when a different service is a better choice. Use respectful, concrete criteria.
fit.a11y_guidance: Name each group in text; never rely on ticks, crosses, or color alone.

inclusions.name: Included and outside scope
inclusions.purpose: Prevent surprises by separating included work from separately agreed work.
inclusions.copy_guidance: List actual deliverables and exclusions. State where the agreed proposal takes precedence.
inclusions.a11y_guidance: Give included and excluded groups explicit headings.

preparation.name: Preparation checklist
preparation.purpose: Help a visitor arrive prepared for a conversation or appointment.
preparation.copy_guidance: List the material needed, why it helps, and alternatives if it is unavailable.
preparation.a11y_guidance: Use a real list and plain instructions; do not make preparation depend on downloading a file.

hours.name: Opening hours
hours.purpose: Show the regular schedule and explain exceptions.
hours.copy_guidance: Confirm timezone, regular hours, holiday exceptions, and whether visits need an appointment.
hours.a11y_guidance: Use day labels and readable time ranges. Explain closed days in words.

visit.name: Plan your visit
visit.purpose: Answer practical arrival and access questions before someone travels.
visit.copy_guidance: Confirm the address, entrance, transport, parking, and access arrangements. Include a contact route for questions.
visit.a11y_guidance: Give written directions and specific access information; a map alone is insufficient.

menu.name: Menu or service list
menu.purpose: Let visitors compare specific items and clearly stated prices or scope.
menu.copy_guidance: Use approved item names, descriptions, units, and prices. Identify dietary or eligibility questions that need confirmation.
menu.a11y_guidance: Keep the menu as readable text. Define symbols and do not hide key information in an image.

events.name: Events and sessions
events.purpose: Explain what is happening, when, where, and how to participate.
events.copy_guidance: Confirm date, timezone, location, access arrangements, and registration status. Remove or update expired sessions.
events.a11y_guidance: State dates and locations in text; explain online or in-person access.

policies.name: Practical policies
policies.purpose: Make important service conditions easy to find before a commitment.
policies.copy_guidance: Use the business-approved wording for booking, changes, cancellation, and other conditions. Record who maintains it.
policies.a11y_guidance: Use descriptive disclosure labels; keep essential terms visible near the relevant action.

glossary.name: Terms explained
glossary.purpose: Explain unfamiliar words where visitors need them.
glossary.copy_guidance: Define only the terms the audience is likely to encounter. Prefer examples and everyday language.
glossary.a11y_guidance: Pair each term with its definition using semantic definitions or labelled disclosures.

support.name: Help and support routes
support.purpose: Route existing customers to the right help without forcing one contact method.
support.copy_guidance: Explain each route, what information helps, and confirmed response expectations. Do not imply live support or guaranteed timing.
support.a11y_guidance: Use meaningful link labels and offer a non-phone route when available.

project-brief.name: Project brief builder
project-brief.purpose: Help visitors organize project details locally and choose an explicit handoff.
project-brief.copy_guidance: Ask only for details useful to an initial conversation. Explain whether answers stay local and what happens after each handoff.
project-brief.a11y_guidance: Use labelled fields, visible progress, keyboard-operable steps, validation, and a clear completion state. Keep a no-JavaScript explanation.

announcements.name: Announcements
announcements.purpose: Explain a temporary change and the next useful action.
announcements.copy_guidance: Confirm the affected service, effective dates, and who updates or removes the notice.
announcements.a11y_guidance: Use explicit headings and dates; static notices must not interrupt with live-region alerts.

booking.name: Booking and next steps
booking.purpose: Explain how to request, confirm, and prepare for an appointment.
booking.copy_guidance: State the real booking route, what constitutes confirmation, and how to request another contact method.
booking.a11y_guidance: Use an ordered list for sequential steps; give links meaningful labels. Do not imply that a request is a confirmed booking.

delivery.name: Delivery and collection
delivery.purpose: Explain fulfilment options and what to check before arranging them.
delivery.copy_guidance: Confirm coverage, collection location, timing, charges, and any conditions. Do not imply live tracking.
delivery.a11y_guidance: Keep each option and its conditions together in text; give tables row and column headings.

access.name: Access and accommodations
access.purpose: Give concrete access information and a route to ask for an accommodation.
access.copy_guidance: Confirm specific entrance, seating, sensory, communication, and assistance arrangements with the owner. Avoid blanket accessibility claims.
access.a11y_guidance: Keep written access details available without a map or phone call; label each disclosure clearly.

eligibility.name: Eligibility and requirements
eligibility.purpose: Explain participation requirements and how to ask about exceptions.
eligibility.copy_guidance: Use owner-confirmed criteria and required documents. Explain alternatives and the review route without deciding eligibility for the visitor.
eligibility.a11y_guidance: State requirements in plain words and use a real list; do not rely on symbols or color.

downloads.name: Documents and downloads
downloads.purpose: Make supporting documents easy to identify before opening them.
downloads.copy_guidance: Name the destination, file format, size when known, and accessible alternative. Link only to a real resource and keep versions current.
downloads.a11y_guidance: Give descriptive link labels and format information; provide an HTML alternative when a document needs it.

specifications.name: Specifications and details
specifications.purpose: Present concrete attributes with units and relevant limitations.
specifications.copy_guidance: Use confirmed measurements, units, compatibility, and scope. Explain conditions and where the definitive specification is maintained.
specifications.a11y_guidance: Pair attribute names with values; use semantic definitions or tables and spell out units.

updates.name: Updates and changelog
updates.purpose: Show dated changes with enough context to understand their effect.
updates.copy_guidance: Use actual dates and distinguish completed changes from plans. Identify who maintains the record.
updates.a11y_guidance: Keep dates as readable text and order the entries consistently; avoid conveying status through color alone.
